experiment: Spend all: labs must spend all their money, 4 setups × 20 runs, $0.15 a lab (Nov 7)

areas.B: Sorting: insertion sort and merge sort on lists of numbers.
areas.D: Search trees and counting (bigger set): insertion into a search tree, tree sort, lists with the same counts, sums.

theorems.name: coprime_q_L
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime q (L p q (n + 1))

theorems.name: L_add
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) : ∀ m n, L p q (m + n + 1) = L p q (m + 1) * L p q (n + 1) + q * L p q m * L p q n

theorems.name: L_le_succ
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) : ∀ n, L p q n ≤ L p q (n + 1)

theorems.name: cnt_append
theorems.statement: (a : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) : cnt a (xs ++ ys) = cnt a xs + cnt a ys

theorems.name: cnt_ins
theorems.statement: (a x : Nat) : ∀ l, cnt a (ins x l) = cnt a (x :: l)

theorems.name: cnt_merge
theorems.statement: (a : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) : cnt a (merge xs ys) = cnt a xs + cnt a ys

theorems.name: cnt_pos_iff_mem
theorems.statement: (a : Nat) : ∀ l, 0 < cnt a l ↔ a ∈ l

theorems.name: mem_ins
theorems.statement: (x z : Nat) : ∀ l, z ∈ ins x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l

theorems.name: mem_merge
theorems.statement: (z : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) : z ∈ merge xs ys ↔ z ∈ xs ∨ z ∈ ys

theorems.name: sorted_iff_pairwise
theorems.statement: : ∀ l : List Nat, Sorted l ↔ l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

theorems.name: det_mul
theorems.plain: The determinant of a product of two 2×2 matrices is the product of their determinants.
theorems.statement: (x y : M2) : det (mul x y) = det x * det y

theorems.name: det_one
theorems.statement: : det one = 1

theorems.name: mul_assoc
theorems.statement: (x y z : M2) : mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)

theorems.name: mul_one
theorems.statement: (x : M2) : mul x one = x

theorems.name: comp_pow
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) : ∀ n,
    pow (comp p q) (n + 1) = ⟨L p q (n + 2), q * L p q (n + 1), L p q (n + 1), q * L p q n⟩

theorems.name: all_iff_mem
theorems.statement: (P : Nat → Prop) : ∀ t, Tree.All P t ↔ ∀ z ∈ Tree.inorder t, P z

theorems.name: all_insert
theorems.statement: (P : Nat → Prop) (x : Nat) (hx : P x) : ∀ t, Tree.All P t → Tree.All P (Tree.insert x t)

theorems.name: lsum_ins
theorems.statement: (x : Nat) : ∀ l, lsum (ins x l) = x + lsum l

theorems.name: L_coprime_succ
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (L p q n) (L p q (n + 1))

theorems.name: L_dvd_mul
theorems.statement: (p q m : Nat) : ∀ k, L p q m ∣ L p q (m * k)

theorems.name: u_dvd_mul
theorems.plain: A term of the sequence divides every term whose position is a multiple of its own: u(m) divides u(m·k).
theorems.statement: (m : Nat) : ∀ k, u m ∣ u (m * k)

theorems.name: u_not_three_dvd
theorems.statement: (n : Nat) (h : 0 < n) : ¬ 3 ∣ u n

theorems.name: cnt_isort
theorems.statement: (a : Nat) : ∀ l, cnt a (isort l) = cnt a l

theorems.name: ins_pairwise
theorems.statement: (x : Nat) : ∀ l : List Nat, l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) → (ins x l).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

theorems.name: merge_pairwise
theorems.statement:
(xs ys : List Nat) (hx : xs.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (hy : ys.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) :
    (merge xs ys).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

theorems.name: pairwise_unique
theorems.statement:
: ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Nat, l₁.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) → l₂.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
    (∀ a, cnt a l₁ = cnt a l₂) → l₁ = l₂

theorems.name: det_pow
theorems.statement: (x : M2) : ∀ n, det (pow x n) = det x ^ n

theorems.name: pow_add
theorems.statement: (x : M2) (m : Nat) : ∀ n, pow x (m + n) = mul (pow x m) (pow x n)

theorems.name: u_mono
theorems.statement: {i j : Nat} (h : i ≤ j) : u i ≤ u j

theorems.name: cnt_inorder_insert
theorems.statement: (a x : Nat) : ∀ t, cnt a (Tree.inorder (Tree.insert x t)) = cnt a (x :: Tree.inorder t)

theorems.name: cnt_reverse
theorems.statement: (a : Nat) : ∀ l, cnt a l.reverse = cnt a l

theorems.name: inorder_pairwise
theorems.statement: : ∀ t, Tree.Search t → (Tree.inorder t).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

theorems.name: L_mono
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) {i j : Nat} (h : i ≤ j) : L p q i ≤ L p q j

theorems.name: lsum_isort
theorems.statement: : ∀ l, lsum (isort l) = lsum l

theorems.name: search_insert
theorems.statement: (x : Nat) : ∀ t, Tree.Search t → Tree.Search (Tree.insert x t)

theorems.name: coprime_three_u
theorems.statement: (n : Nat) (h : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime 3 (u n)

theorems.name: L_gcd_add
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) (m n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Nat.gcd (L p q (m + n)) (L p q n) = Nat.gcd (L p q m) (L p q n)

theorems.name: v_dvd_mul
theorems.statement: (m k : Nat) : v m ∣ v (m * k)

theorems.name: ins_sorted
theorems.statement: (x : Nat) (l : List Nat) (h : Sorted l) : Sorted (ins x l)

theorems.name: msort_pairwise
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : (msort l).Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ∧ ∀ a, cnt a (msort l) = cnt a l

theorems.name: sorted_unique
theorems.statement:
(l₁ l₂ : List Nat) (h₁ : Sorted l₁) (h₂ : Sorted l₂)
    (h : ∀ a, cnt a l₁ = cnt a l₂) : l₁ = l₂

theorems.name: pow_mul
theorems.plain: Matrix powers multiply out: x to the power m·n equals (x to the power m) to the power n.
theorems.statement: (x : M2) (m : Nat) : ∀ n, pow x (m * n) = pow (pow x m) n

theorems.name: cassini
theorems.plain: Cassini's identity for the sequence: u(n+1)² − u(n+2)·u(n) = (−3)ⁿ. Links the sequence to matrix powers.

theorems.name: det_comp_pow
theorems.statement: (p q n : Nat) : det (pow (comp p q) n) = (-(q : Int)) ^ n

theorems.name: firstN_pairwise
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : Nat) : (firstN (L p q) n).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

theorems.name: inorder_sorted
theorems.statement: (t : Tree) (h : Tree.Search t) : Sorted (Tree.inorder t)

theorems.name: same_reverse
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : SameCounts l.reverse l

theorems.name: search_ofList
theorems.statement: : ∀ l, Tree.Search (Tree.ofList l)

theorems.name: L_gcd_add_mul
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) (m r : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∀ k, Nat.gcd (L p q (r + m * k)) (L p q m) = Nat.gcd (L p q r) (L p q m)

theorems.name: u_coprime_succ
theorems.statement: : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))

theorems.name: isort_sorted
theorems.statement: : ∀ l, Sorted (isort l)

theorems.name: cassini_L
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) (hq : 0 < q) (n : Nat) :
    (L p q (n + 1) : Int) ^ 2 - L p q (n + 2) * L p q n = (-(q : Int)) ^ n

theorems.name: inorder_insert
theorems.statement: (x : Nat) (t : Tree) (h : Tree.Search t) : Tree.inorder (Tree.insert x t) = ins x (Tree.inorder t)

theorems.name: same_msort
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : SameCounts (msort l) l

theorems.name: L_gcd
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) (m n : Nat) :
    Nat.gcd (L p q m) (L p q n) = L p q (Nat.gcd m n)

theorems.name: u_gcd_add
theorems.statement: (m n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.gcd (u (m + n)) (u n) = Nat.gcd (u m) (u n)

theorems.name: isort_correct
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : Sorted (isort l) ∧ ∀ a, cnt a (isort l) = cnt a l

theorems.name: msort_eq_isort
theorems.plain: Merge sort and insertion sort give exactly the same list, for any list of numbers.
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : msort l = isort l

theorems.name: isort_u
theorems.plain: Sorting the first n terms of the sequence changes nothing: the sequence is already in increasing order.
theorems.statement: (n : Nat) : isort ((List.range n).map u) = (List.range n).map u

theorems.name: isort_eq_iff
theorems.statement: (l l' : List Nat) : isort l = isort l' ↔ SameCounts l l'

theorems.name: isort_firstN
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : Nat) : isort (firstN (L p q) n) = firstN (L p q) n

theorems.name: tsort_eq_isort
theorems.statement: : ∀ l, tsort l = isort l

theorems.name: u_gcd_add_mul
theorems.statement: (m r : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) : ∀ q, Nat.gcd (u (r + m * q)) (u m) = Nat.gcd (u r) (u m)

theorems.name: v_gcd
theorems.statement: (m n : Nat) : Nat.gcd (v m) (v n) = v (Nat.gcd m n)

theorems.name: isort_same_firstN
theorems.statement:
(p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : Nat) (l : List Nat)
    (h : SameCounts l (firstN (L p q) n)) : isort l = firstN (L p q) n

theorems.name: lsum_same
theorems.statement: (l l' : List Nat) (h : SameCounts l l') : lsum l = lsum l'

theorems.name: tsort_firstN
theorems.statement: (p q : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : Nat) : tsort (firstN (L p q) n) = firstN (L p q) n

theorems.name: u_gcd
theorems.plain: The greatest common divisor of two terms is the term at the gcd of their positions: gcd(u(m), u(n)) = u(gcd(m, n)).
theorems.statement: (m n : Nat) : Nat.gcd (u m) (u n) = u (Nat.gcd m n)

theorems.name: lsum_msort
theorems.statement: (l : List Nat) : lsum (msort l) = lsum l
